claims.claim: Complete engine for Toyota vehicles (RAV4 etc.)
claims.evidence: No badge, VIN plate, or Toyota logo visible in any photo to confirm make/model match.
No import documents, shipping labels, or country-of-origin markings visible.
No video or audio clip of the engine running; photos are static.
No odometer, service record, or donor-vehicle photo shown.
Sticker on block/valve cover present but text illegible; no close-up proving factory seal intact.

risks.risk: Engine may not match the stated Toyota RAV4 model/displacement
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine ID/VIN stamp or casting number on the block
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified-fitment used engine, not RAV4-specific

risks.proof: Video clip of engine running/idling with audio, plus compression test readout
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested, possible rebuild needed

risks.proof: Full-angle photos showing harness connectors, ECU, and all ancillary parts included
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, missing ancillary parts

risks.risk: Hidden leaks, corrosion, or prior accident damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of oil pan, block seams, and underside for leaks/rust

risks.risk: True origin/history (Tokunbo vs locally sourced) unverifiable
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, standard used-engine risk

proof_requests: Close-up photo of engine ID/casting number or VIN sticker, legible
Video of engine running with audio (cold start preferred)
Photos showing ECU, wiring harness ends, and all sensors/injectors
Photo of underside/oil pan and block seams for leak/rust check
Any import or purchase documentation for origin claim
response.reason: The witness confirms a bare used engine exists, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified fitment, condition, and origin) pending the listed proofs.
